meta.title: Dreamlike - 3
meta.description: The swan curtsies, and the curtain falls.

units.rawText: Although she has returned to reality, she is still gazing upon a dreamscape.
units.displayText: Although she has returned to reality, she is still gazing upon a dreamscape.

spans.text: Although she has returned to reality, she is still gazing upon a dreamscape.

units.rawText: Odette closes her eyes and sinks slowly into the Liquid Entropy, while Odile struggles to rise from it.
units.displayText: Odette closes her eyes and sinks slowly into the Liquid Entropy, while Odile struggles to rise from it.

spans.text: Odette closes her eyes and sinks slowly into the Liquid Entropy, while Odile struggles to rise from it.

units.rawText: This is a theater that could not be any more familiar to her. She crafted every tree and every single stalk of grass in this place, and they all move as she wishes.
units.displayText: This is a theater that could not be any more familiar to her. She crafted every tree and every single stalk of grass in this place, and they all move as she wishes.

spans.text: This is a theater that could not be any more familiar to her. She crafted every tree and every single stalk of grass in this place, and they all move as she wishes.

units.rawText: The piano begins to play a new tune, and the music rides a wind from parts unknown that stirs up the branches of the trees.
units.displayText: The piano begins to play a new tune, and the music rides a wind from parts unknown that stirs up the branches of the trees.

spans.text: The piano begins to play a new tune, and the music rides a wind from parts unknown that stirs up the branches of the trees.

units.rawText: The sky grows brighter and brighter. Odile takes step after step into the center of the stage. The light shines on her, and the black swan is washed clean of her filth, as pure and sacred as the white bird that she originally was.
units.displayText: The sky grows brighter and brighter. Odile takes step after step into the center of the stage. The light shines on her, and the black swan is washed clean of her filth, as pure and sacred as the white bird that she originally was.

spans.text: The sky grows brighter and brighter. Odile takes step after step into the center of the stage. The light shines on her, and the black swan is washed clean of her filth, as pure and sacred as the white bird that she originally was.

units.rawText: She raises her wings in a curtsy, and bows to her wretched audience.
units.displayText: She raises her wings in a curtsy, and bows to her wretched audience.

spans.text: She raises her wings in a curtsy, and bows to her wretched audience.

units.rawText: Amidst a baptism of ear-shattering flame, everything falls into silence.
units.displayText: Amidst a baptism of ear-shattering flame, everything falls into silence.

spans.text: Amidst a baptism of ear-shattering flame, everything falls into silence.
